how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DLSA Kamrup Para-Legal Volunteers Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DLSA Kamrup to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DLSA Kamrup to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Kamrup (DLSA Kamrup) for filling various vacant positions in Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under DLSA Kamrup Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) under the official notification memo no. DLSA, Kamrup(M) 2539-42/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in DLSA Kamrup Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 29 vacancies have been announced for the Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required for DLSA Kamrup Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (10th) minimum from a recognized board to be eligible for applying to this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or honorarium for DLSA Kamrup Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an honorarium as fixed by the Assam State Legal Services Authority (ASLSA) instead of a fixed monthly salary.

faq.question: Q6. What are the starting and last dates to apply for DLSA Kamrup Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process starts on 24-09-2026 and the last date to submit the application form is 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for DLSA Kamrup Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications shall be received through online mode at the official e-mail ID, as well as physically through post or direct submission.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for DLSA Kamrup Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by the District Legal Services Authority Kamrup.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DLSA Kamrup Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates involves an Interview/Selection as outlined in the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply for DLSA Kamrup Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at kamrupmetro.dcourts.gov.in to access recruitment notifications and further application details.
